notes.title: Hotfix - Invalid Puzzle
notes.notes:
PC & GB Versions:

Puzzle 9-15 was invalid. If you've already opened this puzzle you don't necessarily need to reset your whole solution but if I tell you exactly what has changed it will reveal the location of a new wall, so I won't mention specifics. It may be best to reset anyway, apologies for the inconvenience.
Fixed a minor visual inconsistency with the background of 5-13.

As always, if you're using the Game Boy version, please remember to swap over to this new ROM so you can receive these fixes.

notes.title: Hotfix - Invalid Puzzle
notes.notes:
Puzzle 3-8 was invalid, this should now been fixed in both the GB and PC versions. Reminder: if you're playing the GB version your game isn't patched until you start using the updated ROM file, that's up to you.

If you've already attempted this puzzle, you should fully reset your solution by highlighting it on the level select screen and holding the marker button, this will fix it and allow it to be solved properly.

notes.title: First Patch - Easier Placement of Walls/Markers
notes.notes: By popular demand, walls will no longer overwrite markers and vice versa. This change only affects the PC version for now.
